set.title: Communicative Challenge: Introducing Yourself the Hungarian Way
set.scenario: At the name-day lunch, Eszter's friend Katalin Horváth meets Ilona néni, Eszter's grandmother, for the first time. You are Katalin.
set.prompt: Greet Ilona néni politely and introduce yourself with your family name first.
cues: Say your name, family name first
set.target: Jó napot kívánok! Horváth Katalin vagyok, Eszter barátnője.
set.english: Good day! I am Katalin Horváth, Eszter's friend.
